about: Split calls from the first look of wave 05.

listings.note: The horse camp (035 to 038) sits about 500 m northeast of the lakeshore sites, and the west loops (016 to 034) about 300 m west of the lake road.
Three shore clusters: the west loop (022 to 029) about 600 m from the middle group (013 to 021), and the east group (001 to 012) 150 m beyond it.
Sites 034 to 039 are a separate lakeshore cluster about 900 m northeast of the main campground.
Sites 1, 2, 3 and a second 002 sit around a field 800 m south of the north campground.
